To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the performance of state of the art MTMC tracking approaches can be improved by using a combination of spatio temporal models with image based ReID, while the state of the MTSC tracking approaches are still far from being satisfactory.

(1) a single network architecture is sufficient for both MTSC and MTMC tracking tasks, (2) spatio temporal models are critical to MTMC tracking, but not MTSC, and (3) image based ReID is a promising approach for vehicle tracking and re identification in urban environments.

(1) a combination of the most recent state of the art approaches for MTSC tracking, detection, and image ReID achieves state of the art performance on CityFlow, (2) a novel spatio temporal model, STGAT, outperforms state of the art baselines in MTMC tracking on the CityFlow dataset, and (3) the combination of STGAT and image ReID improves MTMC tracking by 5% mAP compared to the state of theart
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: Q1 How can we improve the state of the MTMC tracking in the context of urban traffic?
the following questions: 1) How well can existing MTMC tracking approaches scale to a large scale city scale traffic camera network?

the following: (1) the development of a large scale urban traffic dataset with synchronized multi camera data; (2) the design of an evaluation protocol to benchmark the performance of MTMC and MTSC tracking algorithms, object detection and ReID; and (3) the analysis and evaluation of state of the art approaches for each task on this dataset.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CityFlow is a large scale benchmark for multi target multi camera vehicle tracking and ReID, and it is the first of its kind to our knowledge.
CityFlow is a city scale benchmark for MTMC vehicle tracking and ReID, and it is the largest dataset in terms of the number of videos and cameras in an urban environment.
CityFlow is the first city scale MTMC benchmark for vehicle tracking and ReID in an urban environment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a city scale benchmark for multi target multi camera vehicle tracking and re identification.
we are releasing a large scale dataset, a baseline for MTMC tracking and image based vehicle ReID, and an evaluation server for the 2019 Aicity Challenge.
we have developed a large scale urban traffic camera dataset, and conducted a comprehensive evaluation on a variety of tasks, which we believe will be a valuable resource to the research community.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of the state of the arts is still far from satisfactory.
the current state of the art in MTMC tracking is far from being able to handle real world urban traffic camera data.
, with the right network architectures and loss functions, it is possible to achieve state of the art performance on the task of MTMC tracking and ReID.
